defects.title: The model's own 'completed' declaration, overridden by the hold, is never shown
defects.refutation:
The defect's premise is false. rejected_output.status='completed' is not the model's own declaration. No model call in the record returned an output-level status. The core assembler hardcodes "status": "completed" (packages/core/src/lgax_core/planning_agent.py:438) and switches it to held only when the stages declared hold_reasons or unresolved (lines 456-457). The core then rewrites the terminal status to match its decision (lines 625-635).

So for stored core records the web correctly shows no override: the declared_status_overridden note is meant for human-authored fixture declarations (judgement.test.ts:55-73). Rendering the proposed note, "the judgement declared 'completed'", would misattribute a core default to the model.

The information that matters is already on screen and in the exports: the hold decision, its violations, and the rejected candidates under '검사에서 거절된 마지막 후보 … 거절됨'. The mechanical observations are accurate: the flag is false and rejected_output.status is never read. But this is intended behavior, not a display defect.
